notify.title: Gunkly: {chore}
notify.email_footer: You get this email because reminders by email are on in your Gunkly account (Settings, Notifications). You can turn them off there.
notify.test_body: This is a test message from Gunkly. If you can read it, this channel works.
mail.verify.subject: Confirm your email address for Gunkly
mail.verify.body:
Hello,

Confirm your email address to finish setting up your Gunkly account:

{link}

The link works once and expires in {hours} hours. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message.
mail.reset.subject: Reset your Gunkly password
mail.reset.body:
Hello,

Someone asked to reset the password of your Gunkly account. To choose a new password, open:

{link}

The link works once and expires in {hours} hour. Signing in again on all devices will be needed afterwards. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message: your password has not changed.
mail.signupexists.subject: You already have a Gunkly account
mail.signupexists.body:
Hello,

Someone just tried to sign up for Gunkly with this email address, but it already belongs to your account, so nothing was created.

If it was you, sign in at {signin} or choose a new password at {reset}. If it was not, you can ignore this message: your account is unchanged.
mail.otp.subject: Your Gunkly sign-in code
mail.otpconfirm.subject: Your Gunkly confirmation code
mail.emailchange.subject: Your Gunkly email address is being changed
mail.emailchange.body:
Hello,

A change of the email address of your Gunkly account to {newEmail} was requested. It only takes effect once the new address is confirmed.

If this was not you, change your password now and sign out other devices.
mail.securityinvites.subject: Gunkly security notice: a household hit the invite limit
mail.securityinvites.body:
Hello,

The account {username} created {limit} invite links for household {household} within 24 hours, the daily limit, and tried to create more. Creating and revoking invite links over and over can be a sign of abuse.

The attempt is recorded in the audit log. See Administration for recent security events: {link}

You can turn these emails off under Administration, Sign-up & sign-in, Security alerts.
mail.securityadmingranted.subject: Gunkly security notice: a new admin account
mail.securityadmingranted.body:
Hello,

The admin {admin} created the admin account {user} on {time}, which gives it full control of this instance.

If this was not you or another admin you know, an admin account may be compromised: check Administration, Users and the audit log: {link}

You can turn these emails off under Administration, Sign-up & sign-in, Security alerts.
mail.securityalertsoff.subject: Gunkly security notice: security alert emails were turned off
mail.securityalertsoff.body:
Hello,

The admin {admin} turned off security alert emails on {time}. This is the last security email you will get until they are turned on again; events are still listed under Administration.

If this was not you or another admin you know, an admin account may be compromised: check Administration, Users and the audit log: {link}

You can turn these emails off under Administration, Sign-up & sign-in, Security alerts.
mail.securitysignupon.subject: Gunkly security notice: open sign-up was switched on
mail.securitysignupon.body:
Hello,

The admin {admin} switched open sign-up on on {time}: anyone who can reach this instance can now create an account.

If this was not you or another admin you know, an admin account may be compromised: check Administration, Users and the audit log: {link}

You can turn these emails off under Administration, Sign-up & sign-in, Security alerts.
mail.securitysignupoff.subject: Gunkly security notice: open sign-up was switched off
mail.securitysignupoff.body:
Hello,

The admin {admin} switched open sign-up off on {time}.

If this was not you or another admin you know, an admin account may be compromised: check Administration, Users and the audit log: {link}

You can turn these emails off under Administration, Sign-up & sign-in, Security alerts.
mail.securitypowoff.subject: Gunkly security notice: proof of work for sign-up was switched off
mail.securitypowoff.body:
Hello,

The admin {admin} switched off the proof-of-work check for sign-up on {time}, which makes automated sign-ups easier.

If this was not you or another admin you know, an admin account may be compromised: check Administration, Users and the audit log: {link}

You can turn these emails off under Administration, Sign-up & sign-in, Security alerts.
mail.securityegressoff.subject: Gunkly security notice: the outbound-connection guard was switched off
mail.securityegressoff.body:
Hello,

The admin {admin} switched off the outbound-connection guard on {time}. Webhooks and notification channels can now reach private network addresses.

If this was not you or another admin you know, an admin account may be compromised: check Administration, Users and the audit log: {link}

You can turn these emails off under Administration, Sign-up & sign-in, Security alerts.
done.undo_note: Pressed by mistake? You can undo this for 5 minutes.
done.undone_heading: Undone. The chore is open again.
done.invalid_heading: This link is not valid any more.
done.invalid_note: It may have been used, may have expired, or the chore may have changed. Open Gunkly to see what is due.
mail.inactive_warn.subject: Your Gunkly account will be deleted if you stay away
mail.inactive_warn.body:
Hello,

You have not signed in to Gunkly for a long time. To keep our data small and your data safe, accounts that stay inactive are deleted. If you do nothing, your account and your personal data will be deleted on or after {date}. Households where you are the only member with access are deleted with it.

To keep your account, just sign in once:

{url}

If you no longer need it, you do not have to do anything.
mail.inactive_final.subject: Final notice: your Gunkly account will be deleted on {date}
mail.inactive_final.body:
Hello,

This is the final notice. You have still not signed in to Gunkly, so your account and your personal data will be deleted on or after {date}. Households where you are the only member with access are deleted with it. Deleted accounts cannot be restored.

To keep your account, sign in once before that date:

{url}
notify.inactive_warn: Your Gunkly account will be deleted on or after {date} unless you sign in. Open {url} to keep it.
notify.inactive_final: Final notice: your Gunkly account will be deleted on or after {date} unless you sign in. Open {url} to keep it.
oauth.heading: {app} wants to connect to your Gunkly account
oauth.unverified_note: This app registered itself and Gunkly cannot check who made it. Only continue if you just started connecting it yourself.
oauth.new_host: First time: you have not connected an app that returns to {host} before. Make sure that is the address of the app you started connecting.
oauth.confirm_note: Enter your password to allow this connection. Deny needs nothing.
oauth.confirm_note_other: Confirm it is you to allow this connection. Deny needs nothing.
oauth.passkey_failed: The passkey could not be verified. Try again, or use your password and a recovery code.
oauth.sso_failed: Confirming through the identity provider did not work. Try again.
oauth.sso_confirmed: Confirmed. Choose what to allow, then press Allow.
oauth.code_sent: We sent a code to your email address. Enter it below with your password.
oauth.stepup_failed: That did not match. Check your password and code and try again.
oauth.slow_note: Wait a little, then go back and try again.
oauth.action_read: See households, chores and what is due (always)
oauth.action_complete: Mark chores done, snooze, skip and pause them
oauth.action_write: Create and edit chores, manage areas
oauth.guest_note: In households where you are a guest the app can only look, whatever you allow here.
oauth.never_note: It can never change members, settings or your account. You can disconnect it at any time under Settings, AI.
oauth.no_households: You are not in a household yet. Create one in Gunkly first, then connect the app again.
oauth.invalid_heading: This connection request is not valid.
oauth.invalid_note: The app sent an incomplete or unknown request. Close this page and start again from the app.
oauth.session_note: Open Gunkly, sign in, and start connecting the app again.
oauth.limit_note: Disconnect one you no longer use under Settings, AI, then try again.
